slug: 2026-02-16 Nigeria launches nationwide ward-level drive to boost digital ID coverage and inclusion

NGA.note: The document states nothing about authentication services.
The document states nothing about a link to the civil register.

facts.fact: NIMC said it had registered around 127 million people for the NIN by the close of 2025, which is about 53% of the 237.5 million population (share computed from the population held).

NGA.note: Children are to be enrolled in the ward drive, but no number at birth is stated.
The document does not say who operates or maintains the system.
The document names no public register keyed on the NIN.

facts.fact: NIMC runs the national digital ID programme and said it had registered around 127 million people for the NIN by the end of 2025, with a revised target of 180 million by December 2026.
